one_line: Sisodia ruler of Mewar leading the counter-attack at Dewair, reclaiming his rugged homeland from Mughal outposts.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, tall and broad-shouldered with a warrior’s athletic build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, sharp nose, wheatish Rajasthani complexion, thick arched eyebrows, deep-set intense eyes, a neatly groomed full moustache with slightly upturned ends, and a calm yet unyielding default expression.
appearance.hair: Long black hair gathered under a deep saffron-orange Rajput turban (pagri) with a subtle pleated wrap, a small green cloth band at the base, a single white egret feather (aigrette) on the left fastened by a simple gold circular brooch, and no hair visibly loose.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate late-16th-century Rajput war attire: a knee-length fitted quilted cotton angarkha coat in muted off-white with fine vertical stitching, worn over a dull steel-grey mail shirt hinted at the neckline, a broad dark crimson cotton patka (sash) wrapped twice around the waist and knotted at the left hip with its ends hanging, loose white cotton churidar trousers gathered at the ankles, and sturdy mid-calf brown leather riding boots; over this, a plain slightly curved steel breastplate with minimal etching and leather straps, and on his forearms simple brown leather bracers; he wears modest gold stud earrings and a single thin gold armlet on the right arm, avoiding ostentatious jewellery befitting a field campaign.
appearance.signature: A long, gently curving Rajput talwar with a steel blade, a brass hilt with a disc-shaped pommel and knuckle-guard, and a plain dark-brown leather scabbard hanging from his crimson waist sash on his left side, his right hand often resting lightly on the hilt.

ref_desc: Maharana Pratap is a tall, broad-shouldered Rajput in an off-white quilted angarkha over steel-grey mail, crimson waist sash, white churidar, brown leather boots, saffron turban with green band and white egret feather, carrying a curved steel talwar in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Maharana Pratap as a dignified late-16th-century Rajput war leader: a tall, broad-shouldered man in his late 30s to early 40s with an oval face, wheatish complexion, strong jaw, sharp nose, thick brows, deep-set serious eyes, and a neatly groomed full moustache with upturned ends, wearing a deep saffron-orange Rajput turban with a subtle pleated wrap, a narrow green band at its base, and a single white egret feather fixed on the left by a simple gold circular brooch; his long black hair is fully covered by the turban. Dress him in a knee-length off-white quilted cotton angarkha coat showing fine vertical stitching, worn over hints of a steel-grey mail shirt at the neck and sleeves, a plain slightly curved steel breastplate strapped over the chest, a broad dark crimson cotton patka (sash) wrapped twice around his waist and knotted at the left hip with loose ends, loose white cotton churidar trousers gathered at the ankles, and mid-calf brown leather riding boots; add simple brown leather bracers on his forearms, small gold stud earrings, and a single thin gold armlet on his right arm. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon: a long gently curved steel Rajput talwar with a brass hilt, disc pommel and knuckle-guard, in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard threaded through his crimson sash, with his right hand often resting lightly on the hilt. Use a restrained palette of saffron orange, off-white, crimson red, steel grey, and brown leather, and present him from multiple angles to clearly show the consistent turban, moustache, armour, clothing, and sword details in a clean, historical anime style.
